name: io.github.proappstore-online/proappstore
title: ProAppStore
description: Build, deploy, test and operate PAS apps, with authenticated platform and per-app tools.

tools.name: whoami
tools.description: The account this connection is authenticated as — uid, login, email, provider, platform roles, token expiry.

tools.name: mcp_audit_log
tools.description: Your recent MCP audit events (mutating calls, dry-runs, read-only denials), redacted, 90-day retention.

tools.name: list_apps
tools.description: List apps you own or belong to, using connection authentication.

tools.name: deploy_status
tools.description: Check the deploy status of a Pro app (last 5 GitHub Actions runs).

tools.name: schema_status
tools.description: Show an app's D1 migration status (#33) — recent deploy-time migration attempts and whether the latest one applied or FAILED.

tools.name: list_scheduled_runs
tools.description: List recent platform-scheduled registered-action runs for one app, including failures and the change count. Owner-only.

tools.name: list_templates
tools.description: List the approved ProAppStore app templates and the selection contract: id, purpose, supported categories, required SDK/CLI/Node, capabilities, sec…

tools.name: app_info
tools.description: Get info about any app on ProAppStore — live URL, repo, data worker, store listing.

tools.name: platform_guide
tools.description: Get the ProAppStore platform guide (skills.md) for AI-assisted development, with current instructions for building the UI on AppShell with nav.

tools.name: sdk_reference
tools.description: Quick reference for @proappstore/sdk. Start with feature 'shell' (wrap the app in <AppShell app={app} nav={…}>, how to add navigation, a complete minimal app) and 'components' (every UI component), then auth, db, storage, maps, AI and hooks.

tools.name: recipe
tools.description: Get a pre-built code recipe for common PAS app patterns (CRUD list, forms, modals, maps, AI chat, notifications, etc.).

tools.name: list_app_tools
tools.description: One app's registered tools (names, reads/writes, descriptions; params on request).

tools.name: call_app_tool
tools.description: Call one app's registered tool through the platform action executor (mutations audited; refused in read-only mode).

tools.name: provision_pas_app
tools.description: Operator workflow: create or reuse a PAS app GitHub repo from template-app, configure deploy credentials/placeholders, provision platform infrastru…

tools.name: provisioning_status
tools.description: Read historical provisioning evidence plus fresh, current-owner-scoped deployment and route health.

tools.name: scaffold_app
tools.description: Create a new PAS app.

tools.name: write_file
tools.description: Create or overwrite a file in a PAS app's GitHub repo.

tools.name: read_file
tools.description: Read a file from a PAS app's GitHub repo.

tools.name: list_files
tools.description: List all files in a PAS app's GitHub repo.

tools.name: delete_file
tools.description: Delete a file from a PAS app's GitHub repo.

tools.name: search_files
tools.description: Search for text across all files in a PAS app's GitHub repo.

tools.name: get_deploy_status
tools.description: Check the latest deploy status for a PAS app (GitHub Actions workflow runs).

tools.name: provision_app
tools.description: Ensure a PAS app's R2 route and D1, preserving existing data while refreshing its data-worker script and bindings.

tools.name: publish_app
tools.description: Publish a PAS app to the storefront.

tools.name: batch_write_files
tools.description: Write multiple files in a single commit to a PAS app's GitHub repo.

tools.name: add_marketing_site
tools.description: Add template-app's Astro marketing site (home, Privacy, Terms, contact form) to an existing app repo in one commit, never overwriting; equivalent to `pas marketing add`.

tools.name: create_app
tools.description: Create a new Agent Teams project (an app the AI team builds).

tools.name: list_projects
tools.description: List your Agent Teams projects (apps in progress).

tools.name: get_project
tools.description: Get one project's status (play state, cost, repo, etc.).

tools.name: build_knowledge_base
tools.description: Trigger the Architect to research the app (it has live web access) and write/refresh its Knowledge Base (KNOWLEDGE.md + docs/).

tools.name: chat_agent
tools.description: Send a message to a conversational agent.

tools.name: list_tickets
tools.description: List the project's tickets (the kanban) with status + assignee — use to watch the build loop progress.

tools.name: list_agents
tools.description: Show the project's agent team — each agent's identity, system prompt source, skills, and model (the resolved catalog).

tools.name: get_project_files
tools.description: List the project's working-tree files (and optionally read one).

tools.name: set_project_budget
tools.description: Set the project's monthly cost cap in USD (1–1000).

tools.name: set_project_running
tools.description: Play (start) or pause the autonomous build loop.

tools.name: run_tests
tools.description: Trigger a Playwright E2E test run for a project.

tools.name: set_model
tools.description: Set the AI model for a specific agent role (BA, Dev, or QA).

tools.name: add_ticket
tools.description: Add a ticket to the project's backlog directly (bypasses the PO chat).

tools.name: update_ticket
tools.description: Edit an existing backlog ticket's wording: its title and/or its description and reasoning (`rawIdea` — the full statement of what to build/fix and…

tools.name: write_project_files
tools.description: Directly write files into an Agent Teams project's working tree — agent-free build, for when YOUR client writes the code instead of the BYO-key age…

tools.name: delete_project_files
tools.description: Delete files from an Agent Teams project's working tree (agent-free).

tools.name: deploy_project
tools.description: Deploy the project's current working tree with NO agent/LLM — pushes to GitHub and runs CI.

tools.name: agent_project_status
tools.description: Get the agent team's project status for an app — running/paused, monthly cost, budget cap.

tools.name: agent_board
tools.description: Full Kanban board — all tickets with status, assignee, iteration count, cost.

tools.name: agent_activity
tools.description: Activity log (audit trail) for an app's agent team.

tools.name: agent_ticket_detail
tools.description: One ticket's full conversation — all agent messages.

tools.name: agent_cost
tools.description: Cost breakdown for an app's agent team — per-role spend, token counts.

tools.name: qa_list_flows
tools.description: List an app's browser e2e test flows.

tools.name: qa_save_flow
tools.description: Create or update ONE browser e2e test flow (owner only).

tools.name: qa_delete_flow
tools.description: Delete a browser e2e test flow (owner only).

tools.name: qa_run
tools.description: Queue headless browser test run(s) for an app on the platform (Cloudflare Browser Rendering).

tools.name: qa_list_runs
tools.description: List an app's recent test runs (status, steps passed/total, failed step + error, trigger).

tools.name: qa_run_artifacts
tools.description: List a run's screenshot artifacts (name, size).

tools.name: qa_flow_playwright
tools.description: Get a flow transpiled to a Playwright .spec.ts (for CI parity — run the same flow under Playwright).

tools.name: qa_mint_key
tools.description: Mint a scoped QA API key for an app (owner only).

tools.name: inspect_admin_console
tools.description: An app's admin console contract (operator_view) against its current tools: referenced actions, gaps (action_missing, wrong_operation, …), what renders. Owner only, read-only.

tools.name: list_admin_capabilities
tools.description: What an operator_view may contain: resource kinds, column formats, action operations, limits, features, sensitive fields and its JSON Schema (incl. admin_access).

tools.name: preview_admin_console
tools.description: Dry-run an operator_view proposal through the platform validator: tabs, columns, actions, role access matrix, blocked fields. Owner only, stores nothing.

tools.name: propose_admin_update
tools.description: Validate an operator_view proposal without applying it: the platform validator's verdict plus errors, warnings, missing requirements and security issues, each with a path. Owner only.

tools.name: validate_admin_security
tools.description: Security checks on an operator_view proposal: secret exposure, missing actions, destructive without step_up, role errors, row-scoping smells. Returns passesSecurityGates. Owner only.

tools.name: apply_admin_update
tools.description: Commit a validated operator_view to the app repo's mcp.json (one file, never .github/), then report the registration after deploy. Owner only; confirm: true; dry_run.

tools.name: list_enquiries
tools.description: Read-only: list enquiries from your app's about- marketing site, newest first, with new/total counts; filter by status, page with next.before_id. Owner or platform admin only.

tools.name: get_enquiry
tools.description: Read-only: one marketing-site enquiry (name, email, message, status, who handled it). Owner or platform admin only.

tools.name: mark_enquiry_handled
tools.description: Mark a marketing-site enquiry handled (records you and the time), or handled: false to reopen it. Owner or platform admin only.

tools.name: ownership_status
tools.description: Read-only: your relationship to an app's ownership, open transfer/recovery requests you are party to, and the immutable audit record — other parties by login only, never the owner's identity to a non-party.

tools.name: request_ownership_transfer
tools.description: Owner offers an app to a verified PAS account; shows repo/route/data worker/deploy/billing implications first; confirm: true creates a 7-day pending request the recipient must accept.

tools.name: respond_ownership_transfer
tools.description: Accept (confirm: true) or decline a transfer offered to you; cancel one you sent or a recovery request you filed; escalate a stuck transfer to a platform admin.

tools.name: request_ownership_recovery
tools.description: Non-owner with a verified sign-in asks a platform admin to recover an app created under another sign-in; needs evidence; never moves ownership by itself.

tools.name: resolve_ownership_request
tools.description: Platform admins: approve (confirm: true) or reject an escalated ownership request, with a required reason recorded in the audit record.

tools.name: find_apps
tools.description: Read-only: search the app directory you can reach (and your drafts) by id, name, live/store/repo URL or custom domain; filter by lifecycle and access; an exact id reports yours/accessible/unclaimed/reserved/exists_inaccessible; optional live route health.

tools.name: list_oidc_session_grants
tools.description: Platform admins only: list GitHub Actions OIDC e2e session grants and their mint history.

tools.name: create_oidc_session_grant
tools.description: Platform admins only: authorize a repository workflow/ref to mint short-lived non-admin creator sessions as a dedicated smoke account; confirm: true; dry_run.

tools.name: revoke_oidc_session_grant
tools.description: Platform admins only: revoke an OIDC e2e session grant so future exchanges are denied; confirm: true; dry_run.
